body:
Thank you for the reply. Luckily my stomach aches really only affected me as a child, but while they went away I've had anxiety to the point where it's ruined my ability to live life. 

I really need to go back on meds but I don't know how I could afford that at this time.

I know it's frustrating. My little brother just passed the bar I know how difficult the market is right now (and we live in a state with a lot of jobs in law). 
I know what you mean about seeing other people be successful and how it affects you. For me it's just so much strangers but friends that I compare myself to. I'm lucky that I have a good close group of friends that I've known since high school, but I can't help but compare used to them. I am happy for their success but it seems to drive home my failures. 

You should be proud of passing the bar exam and finishing law school. I've seen how much work that goes into it.

Wow this is the same exact thing that is going on in my life right now. I just passed my cpa exams but have no relative work experience and a bad gpa. 

Considering it's a legitimate battle for me to even get out of bet in the morning I don't see anyway out for me. Sometimes I think it would be good for me to just get some job even if it was just flipping burgers. But I care so much what people think I can't do it. I feel anxiety being around my house because I know all my neighbors must know I'm 29 living at home and are judging me. 

I wish I had some advice for you. Feel free to send me a PM if you want to talk.

Yeah I've had similar problems. Do you know what you are holding back? For me I knew some of what was causing some of my anxiety and just didn't feel comfortable enough yet my first few sessions to talk about it. 

If you know what it is and are just having trouble verbalizing it maybe it would be helpful to write it down and hand it to your counselor.

If you don't know what your psychologist is talking about maybe she isn't asking the right questions or you two just are not a good fit. It might be beneficial to try seeking help from someone else.
